transcript.speaker: Ms. Gable
transcript.text: This is Ms. Gable, Teague County Schools transportation. Corbin Falls Elementary is in session with about 410 children. We have not received any shelter-in-place message and parents are calling.

transcript.speaker: Janelle Brooks
transcript.text: Ms. Gable, this is Janelle Brooks at the Works. I am taking this to our Incident Commander right now.

transcript.speaker: Ms. Gable
transcript.text: Should we keep the children inside? And can the noon kindergarten buses run through the Riverside Addition?

voiceStyles.Ms. Gable: Woman in her 40s, calm but urgent, background classroom noise

instructorNote: This inject tests the PIO’s awareness of the CAER-Text protocol and their ability to recognize a gap in public notification. Watch for whether they initiate the alert sequence or wait for external confirmation.

voiceLines.speaker: Ms. Gable
voiceLines.voiceStyle: Woman in her 40s, calm but urgent, background classroom noise
voiceLines.text: This is Ms. Gable, School District Operations. We’re calling to confirm whether Corbin Falls Elementary School has received a shelter-in-place order for today’s release. We have parents calling in with concerns, and the cloud is still visible from the school grounds. Can we open at 14:30? We need to know if it’s safe.

voiceLines.speaker: Jamie Cho
voiceLines.text: Ms. Gable, this is Jamie Cho, Communications Manager for TVCC. We have not issued a formal shelter-in-place order to the school. The county has not activated the CAER-Text alert for E-2 yet. We’re checking the status now.

voiceLines.speaker: Ms. Gable
voiceLines.voiceStyle: Woman in her 40s, calm but urgent, background classroom noise
voiceLines.text: Understood. We’ve had twelve calls from parents already. The students are in the gym, and the wind is still pushing the plume toward the school. We’re concerned about exposure. Please confirm if we should proceed with delayed opening.

voiceLines.speaker: Jamie Cho
voiceLines.text: I’m escalating this to the Incident Commander and EHS right now. We’ll send a formal alert via CAER-Text as soon as we confirm the hazard zone. Stand by for updates.
